prompt:
Locked-off camera, framing holds. All six men stand in place and pump their raised gloved fists upward together on the beat, four times, heads nodding in time, shoulders rolling. After the fourth pump they hold their fists high and still. The red bulb hangs steady. Every hood, gloved hand and suit stays exactly as it is; nobody moves position and no one else appears. SFX: low basement room tone, a dull thud of boots on each beat. No voices.

Thanks.
